subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime helper layer: extended-float to IEEE/BCD formatting, 96-bit packed arithmetic, SEH filtering and memory-access predicates, CRT string collation, Winsock import thunks, and standard stream/locale object vtable construction/teardown.

summary: Proposes a generic runtime-objects subsystem of nine classes across six clusters directly evidenced by the packet: (1) Packed96BitFloat primitives that copy, zero, shift, add and multiply a 96-bit extended float (3 mantissa DWORDs + sign/exponent WORD at +0xA), (2) ExtendedFloatFormatting orchestration that converts extended floats/doubles to IEEE-32/64 or BCD decimal strings via those primitives and lookup-table scaling, (3) StringFormatParseHelpers, (4) MemoryValidityWrappers plus an SEHExceptionFilter, (5) CrtStringCollation, (6) WinsockImportThunks, (7) StreamVtableFixup and LocaleStreamLifecycle for std::istream/ostream construction/teardown. Every packet owner is UnknownObject, so all class groupings are DERIVED/GUESS proposals; field layouts, import targets and status semantics are taken directly from packet field/global/callee references.

function_roles.role: Primitive 16-byte (4 DWORD) block copy used to save and restore extended-float mantissa words; returns source advanced 4 DWORDs.
Unconditional zero-initializer for a 12-byte (3 DWORD) working struct; always returns 0.
In-place right shift of a 3-limb big integer by an arbitrary bit count (whole-word + bit-shift passes).
Converts an internal 80-bit extended float into a 32- or 64-bit IEEE-style output through the output pointer, returning status 0 (normal/zero), 1 (range-exceeded) or 2 (underflow/denormal).
Fills a 6-element u16 format buffer via sub_596245 then parses it through StringParseViaDelegate.
Builds a 6-element u16 buffer via sub_596245 then delegates to DelegationWithStaticData; likely string parse with format descriptor.
Integer-to-string dispatch: signed base-10 negatives take the signed mode of UintToStringConversion; all other values take the unsigned mode.

SEH exception filter matching the MSVC C++ exception signature (0xE06D7363, param[0]==3, param[1]==0x19930520); on match dispatches to the C++ handler wrapper, otherwise calls the validated global handler.
Negated IsBadReadPtr readability predicate: TRUE when the given range is readable.
Negated IsBadWritePtr writability predicate: TRUE when the given range is writable.
Negated IsBadCodePtr code-pointer validity predicate: TRUE when the pointer is a valid readable code address.
Unsigned overflow-checked addition: writes the wrapping sum through the output pointer and returns 1 on carry, 0 otherwise.
Left-shifts a 96-bit value (three DWORDs) by exactly one bit with bit-31 carry propagation.
Right-shifts an in-place 96-bit value by one bit with inter-DWORD carry propagation; returns the pointer.
Parses ASCII digits into a 96-bit fixed-point accumulator (multiply-by-10, add-digit) and normalizes it, storing and returning the exponent word at a3+10.
Formats a double into a fixed-width decimal string via 96-bit packed BCD arithmetic, handling zero, NaN/Inf/Ind/SNaN, scaling and rounding.
Multiplies two packed 96-bit floating-point-like values, normalizes and rounds the mantissa, and returns the product exponent.
Scales a packed 96-bit value by a table-driven factor derived from the exponent, consuming 3 bits (one octal digit) per iteration.
Byte-count, case-insensitive CRT string collation (_mbsnbicoll pattern) mapping CompareString-style 1/2/3 status to signed -1/0/+1 with a 0x7FFFFFFF error sentinel.
Import thunk forwarding socket(af, type, protocol) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk forwarding recvfrom(s, buf, len, flags, from, fromlen) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk forwarding select(nfds, readfds, writefds, exceptfds, timeout) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk forwarding htons(hostshort) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk forwarding send(s, buf, len, flags) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk forwarding recv(s, buf, len, flags) to the Winsock2 IAT slot.
Import thunk tail-calling WSAFDIsSet(fd, fd_set) through the IAT slot; opaque system API wrapper.
Import thunk tail-calling WSACleanup() through the IAT slot; no game-side logic.
std::istream construction helper: installs the istream vftable (0x005B9BA4) at this + vtable[1], then chains to the shared init routine.
Fixed-argument (0,1) delegation stub forwarding to LocaleStreamObjectConstructSimplified.
Restores the std::ostream vftable (0x005B9BAC) into the stream object at the vtable[1]-derived slot, then chains to the shared init routine.
Fixed-argument (0,1) delegation stub forwarding to LocaleStreamObjectConstructSimplified; consistent with a factory entry point.
Fixed-argument (0,1) delegation stub forwarding to LocaleStreamObjectConstructSimplified; locale wrapper entry point.
Virtual status check on a vtable-derived sub-object; on failure ORs error flag 4 into the sub-object state and dispatches via sub_59A5FE.
Writes the vtable pointer 0x005B9BCC at this+0 and returns this; second parameter unused.
Deleting-destructor trampoline: re-bases the pointer back 4 bytes, invokes VtableFixupWithDestructor, then conditionally frees the object.
Deleting-destructor: runs SetLocaleVTableCall cleanup then conditionally frees the object when the low flag bit is set.

classes.name: Packed96BitFloat
classes.responsibility: 96-bit extended-precision packed float: three 32-bit mantissa DWORDs (low, mid, high) plus a sign/exponent WORD at +0xA. Low-level helpers copy, zero, shift, add and multiply this value.

classes.name: ExtendedFloatFormatting
classes.responsibility: Orchestrates conversion of internal extended-precision floats and doubles into IEEE-32/64 outputs or fixed-width BCD decimal strings, using the Packed96BitFloat primitives, lookup-table scaling, and normalization helpers.

classes.name: StringFormatParseHelpers
classes.responsibility: CRT-style __cdecl helpers that build a 6-word format descriptor buffer and delegate parsing/formatting: signed base-10 special case, format-buffer fill via sub_596245, and parse delegates.

classes.name: MemoryValidityWrappers
classes.responsibility: Positive memory-access predicates built on the Win32 IsBadReadPtr/IsBadWritePtr/IsBadCodePtr imports: each negates the import result so TRUE means the range or code pointer is valid.

classes.name: SEHExceptionFilter
classes.responsibility: SEH exception filter that recognizes the MSVC C++ exception signature (record code 0xE06D7363, parameter[0]==3, parameter[1]==0x19930520) and dispatches to a validated global handler otherwise.

classes.name: CrtStringCollation
classes.responsibility: Byte-count, case-insensitive CRT string collation following the _mbsnbicoll pattern, mapping CompareString-style status to signed comparison order with an error sentinel.

classes.name: WinsockImportThunks
classes.responsibility: Thin forwarding thunks to Winsock2 (ws2_32) IAT slots: socket, recvfrom, select, htons, send, recv, WSAFDIsSet, WSACleanup. No local logic; each is a pure import forward.

classes.name: StreamVtableFixup
classes.responsibility: C++ standard stream object construction/teardown helpers that install or restore std::istream/ostream vtable pointers at a slot offset derived from vtable[1], plus a deleting-destructor trampoline.

classes.name: LocaleStreamLifecycle
classes.responsibility: Factory/cleanup/status surface for the locale stream object: fixed-argument construction delegates, virtual status check with error dispatch, and deleting-destructor teardown with conditional free.

state_machines.name: ExtendedFloatStatusSelection
transitions: subnormal/denormal (v7 below v10 - a3[2]) or non-zero mantissa after normalize -> underflow_denormal (status 2)

interfaces.name: WinsockImportBoundary
interfaces.purpose: Isolates all Winsock2 usage behind stateless import-forward thunks so the replacement executable can swap the networking backend without touching game-side call sites.

interfaces.name: AccessValidationPredicate
interfaces.purpose: Positive memory-access predicates guarding pointer dereferences before read/write/code access in subsystems.

interfaces.name: Packed96BitArithmetic
interfaces.purpose: Primitive 96-bit mantissa arithmetic (overflow-checked add, shift-by-one, multiply) shared by the extended-float formatter, decimal parser and BCD formatter.

interfaces.name: ExtendedFloatOutputContract
interfaces.purpose: Converts internal extended floats to IEEE-32/64 outputs with explicit status codes (0 normal/zero, 1 range-exceeded, 2 underflow/denormal).

compatibility_contracts.name: ExtendedFloatToIEEEStatusCodes
compatibility_contracts.description: ExtendedFloatToOutputFormat must return 0 (normal/zero), 1 (range-exceeded) or 2 (underflow/denormal) and write the 32- or 64-bit IEEE-style result to the output pointer, with the exponent shifted into the position given by byte 12 of the format array.

compatibility_contracts.name: WinsockImportForwarding
compatibility_contracts.description: The eight thunk addresses 0x00598648-0x005986A2 must forward unchanged to the Winsock2 IAT slots socket/recvfrom/select/htons/send/recv/WSAFDIsSet/WSACleanup.

compatibility_contracts.name: SEHFilterSignatureMatch
compatibility_contracts.description: The SEH filter must recognize the MSVC C++ exception signature (record code 0xE06D7363, parameter[0]==3, parameter[1]==0x19930520) before dispatching to the C++ handler wrapper, and validate the fallback global handler with CodePointerValidation before invoking it.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamVtableSlotDerivation
compatibility_contracts.description: Stream construction/teardown reads the dword at this+4 (vtable[1]) as a byte offset and installs the std::istream (0x005B9BA4) or std::ostream (0x005B9BAC) vtable pointer at this+offset.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollationResultMapping
compatibility_contracts.description: Byte-count case-insensitive collation maps CompareString-style status (1=less, 2=equal, 3=greater) to signed -1/0/+1 and returns 0x7FFFFFFF as the collation-error sentinel when the helper reports failure.

unresolved: Every packet owner is UnknownObject; all nine class groupings are GUESS/DERIVED architectural proposals inferred from shared helper pools and call relationships, not recovered original classes.

Helpers with no bodies in the packet: sub_595304 (0x00595304), ArrayOf3ZeroCheck (0x00595310), BitArrayClearBitAndZeroFillSubsequentWords (0x0059525D), sub_596245, UintToStringConversion (0x00596C20), StringParseViaDelegate (0x00595524), DelegationWithStaticData (0x0059553A), sub_58FCA0 (special-value string selection), and sub_598A41 (locale stream construction); their contracts are inferred from call sites.

The exact semantics of the a3 format-control array in ExtendedFloatToOutputFormat (thresholds a3[0]/a3[1], bit position a3[2], shifts a3[3]/a3[5], width a3[4], byte-12 exponent placement) are only partially derivable.

The consumer role of the 96-bit value (timestamp/counter) and the exact numeric transform of the lookup tables at 0x005E9C38 and 0x005E9D98 (including the extended-encoding path with first word >= 0x8000) are not evidenced.
The meaning of locale globals dword_8D48E4 and dword_8D46BC (locale/codepage handles) used by the collation helper is not determinable from this packet.

Packet facts report reads of globals 0x008D4210, 0x008D42A0 and 0x008D43C8 (exception-type descriptors / locale-management struct) that do not appear in the decompiled bodies of the delegation stubs; their role is unresolved.
